look_here_first: Start with the inflorescence and leaf arrangement. Buttonbush has distinctive spherical white flower heads with projecting styles that look like pincushions, plus opposite or whorled glossy entire leaves on a wet-site shrub.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays natural flora/riparian documentation + Travis preserve/herbarium records + Williamson County treatment.

best_field_traits: branches often opposite or in whorls of 3
leaves opposite or whorled, simple and entire
long projecting styles create pincushion appearance
strong association with pond margins, streams, and riparian wetlands
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Opposite/whorled glossy leaves + stipules + spherical pincushion flower heads = high-confidence buttonbush.
